classes.uint-range: a basic integer above its width (uint8 256 .. , uint16 65536 ..): validity bound of the scalar
classes.bit-padding: bits above the length of a bit vector (the padding of its last byte) and stray bits of a bit list between its length and its delimiter
classes.limit: a list or bit list one element past its limit, and a vector one element short or long: the validity bound at limit / limit + 1
classes.storage: a collection whose storage cannot hold its length, and a byte length that is not a whole number of elements
classes.field-validity: every field of a container, the field that is out of range among valid ones: the validity of the fields reaches the result
classes.union-payload: a union whose payload is invalid
classes.bool-bytes: a packed boolean vector holding a byte other than 0 and 1
classes.valid-bytes: valid objects at and next to the boundaries: the exact bytes of the serializer (offsets, lengths, padding)
